title: 第一百四十八章 神启（四）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

当第一缕阳光破云而出，照亮窗外一切的时候，艾妮尔还是站在窗前，想着对方离开时给她留下的那句话。

这个世界不会允许你这样的存在！

艾妮尔并不怀疑这句话的真实性，她只是想不明白，明明她的存在已经如此的卑微，说得好听点，是不属于这三类，说得难听点，是这三类根本容不下她这样的存在，所以，她才介于他们之间，用血族的生命做着猎人的工作，进了人类的神学院，却永远也不可能进入天堂，这是一个多么尴尬的位置，倒向谁都可以，但又都不可以，艾妮尔是想选择，可是她却不知道要如何去选择，人类？不可能，人类绝对不可能容得下一个吸血鬼的存在，更别说是在他们之中生活，血族？萨尔的背叛，她已经对唯一可能走的这条路绝望，她可不想进了血国，天天看着萨尔与那个依蜜儿卿卿我我，就算她可以保持平静，对方也一样不会让她有好日子过。诸神？似乎现在只有这一方可以容得下她，但是她很清楚，她不属于那里，呆在天堂只会让她慢慢的质疑，让她失去现在唯一拥有的东西，自己的灵魂。

无种可走的她，在窗前整整站了一夜，淋了一身的夜露，却不觉得冷，因为在她的心里更冷。

“咚咚咚！”第三次的敲门声，她已经懒得去猜门外的是谁，隐约感觉到了一些，不过她并没有去确定，只是轻声应道，“进来！”

“你……”看到站在窗前的艾妮尔，来人不由的一愣。

“你不是找我吗？”艾妮尔没有回头，她也不想去看这位新客人，对于他，她没有任何的兴趣。

“是，可是……”对方似乎有话要说，却又不好意思说。

“什么？”艾妮尔随意的问道。

“现在我已经没什么要确定的了。”说着，对方毫不犹豫的退出了房间，并关上了门。

对于这位自己出现又自己消失的客人，艾妮尔只是觉得有些莫明其妙，回头望了一眼，原本应该空荡荡的地上，竟然放着一只小小的鸟笼，笼子里没有鸟，只是有张小纸条。艾妮尔转走拾起鸟笼，取出纸条，只见上面清清楚楚的写着两个字：天堂。

艾妮尔抬头看了一眼门口，刚才的来人她已经很清楚是谁，可是以她对他的了解，他应该不是会送这种礼物的人，但是，除了他又不可能是别人。

难道说，自己对他的看法错了？

这个礼物的意思很明确，那就是天堂是笼子，如果不想当小鸟，那就最好离诸神远点，不然结果可想而知。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When the first ray of sunshine broke through the clouds and illuminated everything outside the window, Enel still stood in front of the window, thinking about the words the other party left for her when he left.

This world will not allow you to exist like this!

Enel did not doubt the authenticity of this sentence, she just couldn't understand that her existence was already so humble. To put it nicely, she did not belong to these three categories. To put it harshly, these three categories could not tolerate an existence like her at all, so she was between them.Using a vampire's life to do the job of a hunter, entering a human seminary, but never being able to enter heaven, this is such an embarrassing position. You can fall in love with anyone, but you can't. Enel wants to choose, but she doesn't know how to choose, human?Impossible, it is absolutely impossible for humans to tolerate the existence of a vampire, let alone live among them, vampires?Thrall's betrayal made her despair of the only possible path. She didn't want to enter the Kingdom of Blood and watch Thrall and that Yi Mier flirt with each other every day. Even if she could stay calm, the other party would not let her have a good life.Gods?It seems that only this side can accommodate her now, but she knows very well that she does not belong there. Staying in heaven will only make her slowly question and make her lose the only thing she has now, her soul.

With no choice but to leave, she stood in front of the window all night, soaked in night dew, but she didn't feel cold because it was even colder in her heart.

"Dong dong dong!" There was a third knock on the door. She was too lazy to guess who was outside the door. She vaguely felt it, but she did not confirm it. She just responded softly, "Come in!"

"You..." Seeing Enel standing in front of the window, the visitor couldn't help but be startled.

"Aren't you looking for me?" Anel didn't look back. She didn't want to see this new guest. She had no interest in him.

"Yes, but..." The other party seemed to have something to say, but was embarrassed to say it.

"What?" Enel asked casually.

"Now I have nothing to confirm." After saying that, the other party left the room without hesitation and closed the door.

Enel just felt a little confused about this guest who appeared and disappeared by himself. She looked back and saw that there was a small birdcage on the ground that should have been empty. There was no bird in the cage, but a small note.Enel walked away, picked up the birdcage, and took out the note. She saw two words clearly written on it: Paradise.

Enel raised her head and glanced at the door. She already knew who the person who came just now was, but based on her understanding of him, he should not be the person who would give such a gift. However, it could not be anyone else but him.

Could it be that I was wrong about him?

The meaning of this gift is very clear, that is, heaven is a cage. If you don't want to be a bird, you'd better stay away from the gods, otherwise the consequences can be imagined.
